1. Widen the bundle-size glob to cover the new chunk names — `scripts/check-bundle-size.js` reads a hard-coded `main.*.js` pattern, which no longer matches anything after the code-split. Widen it and update the unit test that asserts on the old pattern.
2. Fail the check when the glob matches nothing — the script currently exits 0 on an empty match, which is how the first slice went unnoticed. A reviewer knows this is done when deleting the bundle makes CI red.
3. Record the budget in one place — the ceiling is repeated in the script and in the workflow. Move it to `package.json` and read it from both.

transcript.content: Split issue 816 into at most 8 independently deliverable sub-issues.
Three slices; the second depends on the first landing.
